text: Found it in your video: the yellow 'bets hidden... Scan' note changed height whenever a scan started or ended (the Scan button came and went, so the text re-wrapped), pushing the list down about 10px each time. Fixed: the note is a fixed height and the button stays laid out. It's committed and compiles; it goes out in the next release (I'm holding it to batch with other pending changes unless you want it now).
